model_output.verdict: A mechanical engineer with a clear product design background, but few details about what the work changed.
write_up: You’ve progressed from Mechanical Engineer I to II at Westhaven Office Systems, designing furniture components and leading design for the Arlo desk platform. It’s common for an engineering resume to list the work this way, but without the design decisions or results, it won’t stand out in a pile. I read it for Mechanical Engineer II roles.

Your BIFMA testing line is a useful model: it names both the work and the standard you tested against. Your experience is easy to follow, and your SolidWorks, GD&T and supplier work give a recruiter a good picture of your tools and collaborators.

Let’s start with Arlo. Add what you personally designed or decided, then bring that same detail to the supplier work and engineering changes. A finding, design change or product milestone you can substantiate would give those lines more weight.

cards.question: Which component did you work on with suppliers, and what was your contribution to the tooling or inspection?
